blocks.text: Serial number of the BactoSense. Description of instrument behavior and the work steps when the problem occurred. Description of what you did when trying to solve the problem yourself. Documentation of the third-party products you use in conjunction with the BactoSense. Description of operation conditions (place, power supply, measured medium, temperature etc.). This user manual. Export of the last measurements when the error occurred, see Exporting measurements .
